subject: Regional processing, subprocessors, and cross-border transfer detail for NorthBridge
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@northbridge.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@northbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on where HelioPay customer data is actually processed

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our legal team asked me to collect a few concrete items before we move to procurement: we need a short written explanation of where HelioPay production requests (and derived artifacts) are processed, which subprocessors see data, and what cross-border controls are in place. Specifically:

1) For US customers that opt into regional isolation, where does inference execution occur (control plane vs runtime)?
2) Which subprocessors in EU/APAC could receive any logs or telemetry?
3) Do you rely on SCCs/other transfer mechanisms for any cross-border movement?
4) How is deletion of customer-generated content demonstrated (timeline & evidence)?

If you can share a one-page summary + inventory CSV and any evidence links, that would be ideal.

Appreciate a response this week if possible — procurement has a tight window.

Best,
Elena
Chief Privacy Officer
NorthBridge AI

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@northbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on where HelioPay customer data is actually processed

Hi Elena —

Thanks — happy to spell this out. Attaching a concise processing map and our subprocessor inventory CSV. Quick summary below (TL;DR first):

- Runtime (inference) execution: can be pinned to a regional runtime pool (US: us-west-2 / us-east-1; EU customers: eu-west-1; APAC customers: ap-northeast-1) when you opt for regional execution. If you choose hosted API without regional pinning, requests are routed to the nearest healthy pool (typically us-west-2 for NA).

- Control plane: centralized control plane (managed by Redwood) runs in multi-region control-plane replicas (US/EU). The control plane handles orchestration, billing, and tenant metadata only — not raw request payloads. We never store full customer prompts in the control plane.

- Subprocessors that may see logs/telemetry: our inventory lists cloud infra (AWS), metrics/observability (Datadog - EU region for EU-tenants), and a key-management partner (HashiCorp Vault/managed HSM provider). For APAC routing we use a regional edge partner (EdgeServe APAC) who may temporarily buffer requests for routing; buffering is limited to <30s and is encrypted in transit.

- Cross-border transfers and safeguards: when data moves outside the tenant's region (e.g., aggregated metrics or fallbacks), transfers are governed by standard contractual clauses (SCCs) for transfers from EU to US, supplemented by our DPA commitments. For customers that require no transfers, we offer Private deployment (VPC) or Dedicated pools that keep runtime and logs in the chosen geography.

- Deletion / retention: customer data retention policy defaults to 30 days for request-level logs, with an option to reduce to 0 days (ephemeral) for paid tiers. Deletion is asynchronous but completed within 72 hours for standard retention changes; on Private/Dedicated we can do immediate garbage-collection upon contractually agreed triggers. Evidence: we can provide deletion audit entries (timestamped) and a sample deletion run (CSV) under NDA.

I put the short processing map (redwood_residency_map_20261102.pdf) and the subprocessor inventory (subprocessor_inventory_20261102.csv) in the attachments.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa will share commercial options for regional Dedicated pools if you need strict residency.
- Jonas can provide SCC/DPA templates and signing timeline.

If you want a one-pager formatted specifically for your procurement checklist, tell me which line items are mandatory and we'll tailor it.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive – Solutions
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on where HelioPay customer data is actually processed

Elena —

Adding a couple commercial clarifications:

- Dedicated / regional isolation: we offer two commercial paths to ensure no cross-border runtime processing: (1) Dedicated monthly pools hosted in the region (minimum commitment), or (2) Private (VPC) deployment where entire stack sits in your account/region. Pricing and lead time differ; I attached a short DPA + SCC template (DPA-SCC-template-Redwood-2026.docx) we typically start with.

- Evidence & audit support: for enterprise contracts we include audit evidence (deletion logs, subprocessor attestations, and SOC2 type II report excerpts) as part of the procurement package. If you need an export of deletion audit entries for a quick sample, Connor — please confirm we should produce that under the mutual NDA.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute session with your legal/infosec to go line-by-line. Availability: Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@northbridge.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on where HelioPay customer data is actually processed

Connor / Marissa —

Thanks, this is helpful. A couple follow-ups before I schedule procurement:

- Can you confirm whether the regional edge partner (EdgeServe APAC) is acting purely as a TCP/TLS passthrough or whether they persist any request artifacts? Your note about buffering <30s helps but legal needs to confirm non-persistence.
- For the deletion evidence: we will need a sample CSV of deletion audit entries with timestamps and object ids (redacted where necessary). Please indicate whether that export can be produced without sharing other customers' metadata.
- Finally, for SCCs: can Jonas send the clauses you rely on (we prefer to see clause references rather than a generic statement)?

If you can share the three small items above by end of day Friday we can keep the procurement timeline intact. Also please include a point person for the DPA execution.

Best,
Elena
Chief Privacy Officer
NorthBridge AI
